title: Deploy checklist & risk sprint brief — weekly proservices sync (2026-07-07)
body:
Context: Weekly cross-team sync focused on immediate customer deployments (pilot and GA ramp). Primary goal: surface high-risk items and confirm owners for remaining pre-launch tasks. This doc captures notes from the 07-Jul-2026 proservices + solutions engineering standup and the tactical decisions taken for three active integrations (AtlasHealth, FinLedger, NovaRetail).

Attendees: Asha Patel (owner), Liam Chen (solutions engineer), Sofia Martinez (proservices PM), Rajiv Menon (SRE), Evelyn Park (deployment engineer), Tomás Rivera (customer success), plus engineering reps on ad-hoc items.

Agenda:
1) Quick status by customer
2) Live blockers and risk table
3) Deploy checklist verification (infra, security, keys, monitoring)
4) Action items and owners
5) Timeline confirmation and contingency

Executive summary:
- AtlasHealth: On track for pilot on 2026-07-14 pending one MSA signature and a final security scanner pass. Main risk = KMS key provisioning delay (inflight, owner: Evelyn). Mitigation: use temporary key with strict TTL if KMS not ready by EOD 2026-07-09.
- FinLedger: Blocked by customer-side network policy (outbound CIDR). Internal workaround tested (relay via customer VPC peering) but needs legal signoff for data path; medium risk. Owner: Tomás for customer comms, Rajiv to prepare fallback route doc.
- NovaRetail: Rolling deploy in dedicated capacity; observed 2–3% higher latency under representative load. Root cause likely model quantization mismatch on the A100 Q5 profile. Owner: Liam to coordinate with runtime team for kernel tuning; low-to-medium risk for GA but not critical for pilot.

Detailed notes by customer:

AtlasHealth (pilot -> pilot-go / target 2026-07-14):
- Current status: staging integration complete; smoke tests passing except for encryption-at-rest verification.
- Blocker: KMS provisioning delayed due to onboarding paperwork (security). Evelyn working with security to expedite.
- Ops checklist:
  - VPC peering requested: done
  - KMS keys: pending (target 2026-07-09)
  - Monitoring dashboards: baseline created (SLO: p95 <= 220ms for gen endpoints)
  - Audit/log streaming to customer SIEM: initial pipeline validated
- Decisions: If KMS not available by 9-Jul, deploy with ephemeral encryption keys and rotate on formal KMS provisioning. Documented rollback steps exist.
- Action items:
  1) Evelyn: escalate KMS provisioning and confirm by 2026-07-09 (JIRA-PS-4923)
  2) Sofia: get final MSA signature; target 2026-07-10
  3) Asha: prepare go/no-go checklist and communicate to execs by 2026-07-12

FinLedger (pilot, target soft-launch 2026-07-21):
- Current status: deployment infra ready, customer has strict egress rules that block Redwood endpoints.
- Blocker: outbound CIDR firewall rules. Customer security has requested detailed data-flow diagram and an incident response playbook before allowing exceptions.
- Workarounds explored:
  - Private link / peering + strict ACLs (requires legal signoff)
  - Customer-hosted relay (adds latency ~40ms) — tested as proof-of-concept
- Risk: medium until legal signs off on data path; potential schedule slip of 1–2 weeks.
- Action items:
  4) Tomás: coordinate with FinLedger security to provide data-flow diagram and IR playbook by 2026-07-09
  5) Rajiv: draft fallback topology (relay) with estimated latency and costs by 2026-07-08 (attach to JIRA-PS-4987)
  6) Sofia: alert sales that soft-launch may slip; prepare customer-facing timeline adjustments by 2026-07-10

NovaRetail (dedicated capacity GA ramp, phased 07/20–08/10):
- Current status: dedicated GPU pool provisioned; initial load test at 60% of target QPS shows average tail latency increase.
- Observations: quantized model variant (Q5) exhibits higher token latency on longer sequences. Memory & kernel trace points to suboptimal kernel selection for attention ops on current runtime.
- Decision: pause full GA ramp until runtime tuning attempt completes; continue limited traffic ramp for correctness testing.
- Action items:
  7) Liam: collect perf traces and open a runtime tuning ticket with research/serving runtime (PRF-rt-2026-07) by 2026-07-07
  8) Rajiv + Evelyn: run controlled canary with different kernel flags on 2026-07-09 and report results same day
  9) Customer success (Tomás): communicate pause and rationale; set expectation for updated GA date by 2026-07-10

Risk register (summary):
- High: KMS provisioning delay for AtlasHealth (probable)
- Medium: FinLedger legal signoff for peering / relay (possible)
- Medium: NovaRetail kernel/perf tuning (possible, mitigatable)
- Low: console metrics retention limits affecting long-tail troubleshooting (monitoring ticket created)

Infra & deployment checklist (items verified / outstanding):
- Secrets & keys (owner: Evelyn): pending (AtlasHealth KMS)
- Networking (owner: Rajiv): ACLs and peering templates ready; waiting on customer config for FinLedger
- Observability (owner: Liam): dashboards and alert rules pushed to prod; need two more anomaly tests for NovaRetail
- Runbooks (owner: Sofia): final runbook templates drafted; customer-specific sections pending for FinLedger
- SLA docs and SLOs (owner: Asha): draft shared with customers; awaiting signature confirmation on AtlasHealth MSA

Open decisions requiring PM/Eng alignment:
- Approve ephemeral-key contingency flow for AtlasHealth if KMS misses deadline (Asha + Security) — deadline 2026-07-09
- Accept relay topology for FinLedger if legal allows with signed addendum (Sofia + Legal)
- Permit limited GA ramp for NovaRetail while runtime tuning continues (eng + product)

Meeting action item tracker (single-line summary):
 1) Evelyn: KMS escalation (AtlasHealth) — due 2026-07-09 — JIRA-PS-4923
 2) Sofia: secure MSA signature (AtlasHealth) — due 2026-07-10 — linked to salesforce:OPP-3412
 3) Asha: publish go/no-go checklist & exec note — due 2026-07-12
 4) Tomás: FinLedger security docs & comms — due 2026-07-09
 5) Rajiv: fallback relay design & perf/cost estimate — due 2026-07-08 — JIRA-PS-4987
 6) Liam: runtime perf traces for NovaRetail + open tuning ticket — due 2026-07-07
 7) Rajiv & Evelyn: canary run with kernel flags for NovaRetail — scheduled 2026-07-09

Notes / miscellany:
- Quick wins: create a short template (1 page) for customers that lists minimal required firewall changes and a pre-filled VPC peering form — action: Rajiv to draft template by 2026-07-10.
- Risk optics: suggest weekly risk highlight email to GTM execs for customers in "medium" or "high" risk until launch completes. Asha to take point for this until next Monday.
- Slack threads referenced: #proservices-atlashealth, #proservices-finledger, #proservices-novaretail. Please do not update live configs without PR + approval.

Next sync: 2026-07-14, same time (tactical day for AtlasHealth go/no-go). If any high-severity blocker appears before then, owners to DM Asha and open a priority tag on the JIRA ticket.

End notes: This doc is a working record — please add inline comments for any missing details and update your respective JIRA tickets. Keep the customer comms tight and avoid promising dates until MSA and KMS are confirmed for AtlasHealth.
